title: Parts Billing, Customer-Supplied Parts and Special Orders — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Parts billing under Service Accounts and Repair Orders.** Customer-pay parts are billed at parts list price less the tier's parts discount, rounded to the cent per concern line. Where the tier excludes tires from the discount, tires are billed at list price with no discount.

**Customer-supplied parts.** Parts the customer supplies are installed only where the tier allows customer-supplied parts; they are not billed, and they carry no repair warranty.

**Special-order parts.** A special-order part (not stocked, ordered for this customer) requires a deposit of the tier's special-order deposit share of its price when it is ordered, posted as a special-order deposit fee and applied to the part when it is installed. A special-order part the customer cancels after it is ordered is charged the tier's restocking share of its price as a parts restocking fee, and the rest of the deposit is credited back.

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Ordinary part, customer pay | List price less the tier's parts discount, rounded to the cent per concern line |
| Tire, on a tier that excludes tires | List price, no discount |
| Part the customer brings, tier allows it | Installed, not billed, no repair warranty |
| Part the customer brings, tier does not allow it | Not installed |
| Special order placed | Deposit posted at the tier's deposit share |
| Special order cancelled after ordering | Restocking fee at the tier's share; rest of the deposit credited back |

**Hypothetical.** Parts listing 240.00 on a line at a 5% parts discount are billed 228.00. A special-order part of 500.00 with a 50% deposit and a 20% restocking share: deposit 250.00; on cancellation the restocking fee is 100.00 and 150.00 of the deposit is credited back.
